value: With the preparations complete, the blue trail returned to the sea. Narain sent the adventurers to the Bay of Storms in Azshara with the arcanite buoy, warning them of Maws. The creature that held the shard could be drawn from hiding, but recovering it demanded companions ready for the danger that answered. When the blue fragment was won, the instructions were at last simple: carry it to Anachronos. An old dragon's elaborate concealment had become a journey through much of Azeroth before ending on its storm-bound coast.
